purpose: Five fc.AsyncCommand<ModelStateMD, RealSystemMD> classes for group lifecycle (create, invite, leave, rename-device, forget-device) in the multi-device same-pubkey property test harness.

public_api.name: CgCommand_MD
public_api.description: A1 creates the group on pageA1 only. check: m.groupId===null && !m.membersA1. run: createGroup(pageA1), captures groupId, sets membersA1, records epoch.

public_api.name: InCommand_MD
public_api.description: A1 invites B from pageA1. check: m.membersA1 && !m.membersB. run: settle, inviteByNpub, reload B, selectGroup on B, sets membersB, records epoch.

public_api.name: LgCommand_MD
public_api.signature: class LgCommand_MD implements fc.AsyncCommand<ModelStateMD, RealSystemMD> { constructor(device: Device) }
public_api.description: Device leaves via its own page. check: m.deviceIsMember(device) && m.groupId!==null. run: locator-direct leave. Identity-A 2→1 semantics when A1 leaves while A2 still in.

public_api.name: RdCommand_MD
public_api.signature: class RdCommand_MD implements fc.AsyncCommand<ModelStateMD, RealSystemMD> { constructor(device: Device, newName: string) }
public_api.description: Renames the device on the device's own page. check: m.deviceIsMember(device) && m.groupId!==null. run: renameDevice(r.page(device), ...).

public_api.name: FdCommand_MD
public_api.description: A1 forgets A2's leaf (multi-leaf same-pubkey case). check: m.membersA1 && m.membersA2 && m.groupId!==null. run: leafIndexesFor, pick non-self leaf, forgetLeafByIndex, poll leaf count drops by 1.
